title: Fenwick Tree: Prefix Sum Queries
statement:
Given an array of N integers, answer Q range sum queries using a Fenwick Tree (Binary Indexed Tree).

For each query (L, R), print the sum of elements from index L to R (1-indexed, inclusive).

A Fenwick Tree supports prefix queries in O(log N).
inputFormat:
The first line contains N and Q.
The second line contains N integers.
The next Q lines each contain L and R.
outputFormat: Q lines, each the sum of A[L..R].

starterCode.python:
n, q = map(int, input().split())
arr = list(map(int, input().split()))
queries = [tuple(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(q)]
# Write your solution here
# Hint: BIT[i] covers sum of a range ending at i
